## Data Science Ethics Blog

1. 
The ethical dilemma I chose to study is the usage of Flock's cameras for license plate recognition. Founded in 2017, Flock Group Inc. uses AI-powered search software and cameras to scan vehicles in all 50 states (Flock Safety). I used Chad Marlow's article "Despite 'New' Updates, Flock's Creepy Cameras Remain Major Civil Liberties Threat" to gain insight into the criticism of Flock's data collection and data usage. Additionally, I drew from Christopher Armenta's article published in The Guardian to better understand the impacts of the San Diego City Council's recent vote to end their contract with Flock Safety. 




#### References
Armenta, C. (n.d.). San Diego City Council votes to end Flock Safety contract. The UCSD Guardian. Retrieved November 25, 2026, from https://ucsdguardian.org/2026/11/23/san-diego-city-council-votes-to-end-flock-safety-contract/

Flock Safety. (n.d.). Retrieved November 25, 2026, from https://www.flocksafety.com
